digest.component_or_area: review gates (plan review and code review)
propositions: Plan review and code review use partially independent discovery paths that allow policy inconsistencies such as disabled built-ins, omitted project criteria, and failure-status mistakes.
A unified discovery architecture with immutable repository-bound effective-policy snapshots, shared typed executor, and gate-owned verdict policies must replace the current fragmented paths.
Code-review project LLM criteria require non-empty repository-relative globs; empty lists must migrate to ['**'] with audit of all references and documentation.
Plan-review budget omission preserves existing per-review cap behavior; code-review omission remains uncapped; explicit usd_budget values are authoritative on both gates.
The --retry subcommand must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing calls, and refuse stale lineages before any model call.
New digest-complete checkpoint namespace must separate from legacy checkpoints; discovery traces must be versioned and typed for audit and diagnostics while keeping review responses narrow.
